stem:
Study the diagram and answer the question that follows.

New England During the Colonial Period

• Depended on shipbuilding
• Had excellent harbors

The Mid-Atlantic During the Colonial Period

• Depended on farming
• Had rich, fertile soil

Which effects correctly replace the numbers in this cause-and-effect diagram?

options.label: F
options.text:
(1) Used slave labor
(2) Used Chinese laborers

options.label: G
options.text:
(1) Exported dried fish
(2) Exported agricultural goods

visual_elements:
Diagram with two cause-effect boxes:
Box 1: New England During the Colonial Period - bullets: Depended on shipbuilding, Had excellent harbors -> blank labeled 1
Box 2: The Mid-Atlantic During the Colonial Period - bullets: Depended on farming, Had rich fertile soil -> blank labeled 2
